mapper.insert: insert into community_notice (title, content, type, cover_image, is_top, view_count, publish_time, status) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{coverImage}, #{isTop}, #{viewCount}, #{publishTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: select * from community_notice where is_top = 1 and status = 1 order by publish_time desc
select * from community_notice where status = 1 and type = #{type} order by is_top desc, publish_time desc
select * from community_notice where status = 1 order by is_top desc, publish_time desc
mapper.update: update community_notice set view_count = view_count + 1 where id = #{id}
